'''Larry Hutson''' was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 112 from Bellevue, Nebraska.<ref name="decsq-bespin" /> At DecipherCon 1999 he finished 17th in the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship (Open Champs).<ref name="dc99yj05_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Young Jedi World Championship (Open Champs)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010105010700/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ05_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Hutson playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
